/item/temp-mail.text: HomeCategoryProductivityTemp MailTemp MailLearn when to use a temporary email address. Discover seven practical ways TempMail100 can help reduce spam and protect your personal inbox.Visit WebsiteSaveVisit WebsiteIntroductionYour personal email address is valuable. It is connected to important accounts, private conversations, and password recovery options. Sharing it with every website can result in unwanted newsletters, spam, and an overcrowded inbox. A temporary email address gives you more control. With TempMai l100, you can quickly get a disposable inbox for short-term online activities without revealing your primary email address. Here are seven practical situations where temporary email can be useful. 1. Trying a New Online Service You may want to explore a website before deciding whether it deserves a place in your inbox. A temporary email address allows you to complete an initial signup while keeping your personal address private. If the service proves useful and trustworthy, you can create a permanent account later with your preferred email address. 2. Downloading Free Resources Many websites ask for an email address before allowing you to download a guide, template, report, or ebook. Some of these websites may send promotional messages afterward. Using a disposable email address helps you access the resource without adding more marketing emails to your main inbox. 3. Receiving a One-Time Verification Email Some platforms require email confirmation before granting access to a feature or piece of content. If you only need the account briefly, a temporary inbox may be a convenient option. With TempMail 100, you can receive the verification message directly in your browser. 4. Testing Websites and Apps Developers and QA testers often need multiple email addresses to test registration forms, onboarding flows, and email notifications. A temporary email service can simplify this process. It allows testers to create short-term inboxes without setting up several permanent accounts. 5. Joining Short-Term Promotions Online stores, event pages, and promotional campaigns sometimes require an email address to provide a discount code or limited-time offer. If you do not want to receive long-term promotional emails, using temp mail can help keep your personal inbox organized. 6. Reducing Spam Exposure Sharing your main email address across many websites increases the chance that it will eventually receive unwanted messages. A temporary inbox acts as a buffer. It is especially helpful when you are unfamiliar with a website or uncertain about how your contact information will be used. 7. Keeping Work and Personal Email Separate Your permanent inbox should be reserved for messages that matter. Using disposable email for minor registrations can make it easier to find important emails from colleagues, clients, friends, and family. How to Use TempMail 100 Getting started takes only a few steps: Go to TempMail 100. Copy the temporary email address displayed on the website. Use the address for your short-term online activity. Return to the temporary inbox. Refresh the page to check for new messages. The basic service is free to use and does not require registration. When Not to Use a Disposable Email Address Temporary email is designed for short-term, low-risk tasks. Do not use it for accounts that you may need to access again later. Avoid using disposable email for: Banking and financial accounts Healthcare portals Important work accounts Long-term subscriptions Social media profiles you want to keep Services that may require password recovery For these situations, a secure permanent email address is the better choice. /item/crawlready.description: Make your JavaScript site visible to AI crawlers. Only 31% render JS. CrawlReady fixes this in 5 minutes with citation tracking and schema injection.
/item/crawlready.text: HomeCategoryBusinessCrawlReadyCrawlReadyMake your JavaScript site visible to AI crawlers. Only 31% render JS. CrawlReady fixes this in 5 minutes with citation tracking and schema injection.Visit WebsiteSaveVisit WebsiteIntroductionCrawlReady is an innovative AI Interface Layer designed to make JavaScript-heavy websites fully visible and optimized for modern AI crawlers like GPTBot, PerplexityBot, and ClaudeBot. Many AI crawlers do not execute JavaScript, leading to a significant visibility gap where they perceive websites as blank pages or empty divs, missing crucial content and structured data. This results in a lack of citations in AI answers, reduced organic discovery, and a missed opportunity in the rapidly evolving AI search landscape. CrawlReady addresses this critical issue by sitting between your website and AI crawlers, automatically fixing rendering gaps, injecting LLM-optimized schema, and serving content in the perfect format for every bot. The solution requires zero code refactoring or infrastructure changes on your end, offering a simple one-line integration via a script tag or middleware. Key features include: AI Crawler Analytics (Live Now): Monitor visits from GPTBot, PerplexityBot, and ClaudeBot in real-time. Understand which pages AI crawlers access, their frequency, and the content they receive. Get live data within minutes of integration. One-Line Integration (Live Now): Integrate effortlessly with a single script tag or a few lines of middleware (compatible with Next.js, Express, Cloudflare Workers). It works seamlessly with any frontend stack without requiring SSR migration. AI Readiness Score (Live Now): Instantly scan any URL to receive a comprehensive score detailing your website's AI crawler readiness, including crawlability, schema coverage, and content parity. Publicly shareable score URLs are available without needing an account. AI Interface Layer (Coming Soon): A powerful middleware that intelligently detects bot user-agents, renders JavaScript content, enriches HTML with LLM-optimized Schema.org markup, and serves the most effective format to AI crawlers, all without altering your production code. Auto-Fix JS Rendering (Coming Soon): Solves the problem of blank pages seen by AI crawlers on React, Vue, and Angular SPAs. CrawlReady automatically renders JavaScript, caches the fully hydrated HTML at the edge, and serves it to bots, ensuring no impact on user experience. Auto-Create Schema (Coming Soon): Dynamically generates LLM-optimized Schema.org JSON-LD from your page content. It supports various types like FAQPage, Article, Product, and more, linking them into a cohesive entity graph, all detected and injected automatically with zero configuration. CrawlReady is ideal for JavaScript-heavy businesses, including: JavaScript SaaS Platforms: Product-led growth companies with 500-50K pages that need AI search visibility to drive signups. E-Commerce Stores: Headless commerce and custom React storefronts with extensive product SKUs, aiming for better product visibility in AI shopping recommendations. Technical Content Publishers: Blogs and documentation sites with articles and code snippets that want to be cited as authoritative sources in AI developer tools. Enterprise Portals: Large-scale customer portals and knowledge bases seeking to make support documentation accessible via AI assistants to reduce support tickets. The AI search revolution is happening now, with over 500 million AI search users globally. Early adopters who optimize for AI citations today will gain a significant first-mover advantage. CrawlReady offers a cost-effective solution, saving substantial development and maintenance costs compared to DIY rendering pipelines, with a high ROI in qualified leads and organic discovery. /item/faceless-reels.text: HomeCategoryVideoFaceless ReelsFaceless ReelsCreate faceless reels with AI scripts, scene prompts, script drafts, captions, and reusable workflows for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.Visit WebsiteSaveVisit WebsiteIntroductionFaceless Reels Faceless Reels is an AI-assisted studio for creating faceless short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. It brings the planning and generation stages into one focused workflow so creators can move from an idea to reusable video assets without appearing on camera. What you can do Develop hooks, angles, and script drafts for short-form content. Break a script into scenes and prepare matching visual prompts and captions. Generate clips from text prompts or animate reference images with supported AI video models. Adjust model-specific settings such as framing, motion, duration, resolution, lighting, mood, and visual style when those controls are available. Review generated results, keep useful prompts and settings, and reuse successful structures for future videos. Organize creative work for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts in one place. A practical workflow Faceless Reels is built around three clear stages. First, plan the angle, hook, and script. Next, direct each scene by choosing the prompt, reference image, model, and generation settings. Finally, produce and review the clips, download the results you want to keep, and reuse the strongest prompt patterns in later projects. This workflow is useful for solo creators, marketers, small teams, and channel operators who want a repeatable process for educational videos, product explainers, story-led clips, list videos, and other faceless formats. Instead of switching between separate writing notes, prompt documents, and generation tools, the project keeps the creative context together. Why it is useful The product focuses on the parts of faceless video creation that usually take the most coordination: turning a rough idea into a concise script, keeping scenes visually consistent, preparing useful generation prompts, comparing outputs, and preserving what worked. It does not require creators to film themselves, and it supports both text-led and reference-image-led production paths.
